result_text:
The Duplication report now has a "Most Frequent Duplicates" section right after "Longest Duplicates". The `reports` module tests pass. I didn't run an analysis to look at the generated report.

- **Report section:** `addMostFrequentDuplicatesList` was already written in `DuplicationReportGenerator.java` but never called. It produces the description and table you specified, and leaves the section out when there are no such duplicates. I added the call after the longest-duplicates step.
- **"Code" links:** in `DataExporter.java`, when `saveCodeFragments` is on, the most frequent duplicates are now saved as `most_frequent_duplicates/most_frequent_duplicates_<n>.<ext>`, next to the longest duplicates and duplicated units.
- **Source files (extra):** I also added the most frequent duplicates' source files to the referenced-files set in `DataExporter.java`, mirroring what the longest duplicates get. You didn't ask for this; it's there so the table's file links resolve the same way.
